name: @sensegrep/mcp

tools.name: sensegrep_search
tools.description: Semantic + structural code search. Languages: typescript, javascript, python, java, vue

hybridMode.description: Parallel (default) collects both signals; adaptive opts into lexical skipping

jev.description: Jev source evaluation via OpenRouter: defaults to both with a dedicated Jev credential, otherwise off. Explicit off disables remote evaluation.

jevBatchSize.description: Maximum candidates per Jev request (default 5; byte budget can split batches)

jevStages.description: Explicit Jev stages for ablations; requires Jev enabled

jevPanel.description: Jev panel: staged default, composite legacy, score/noul relevance ablations

jevRanking.description: Jev ranking strategy (default eligible; ignored for evidence-only)

jevCandidates.description: Maximum Jev candidate evaluations (default 32 implementation packages for context, 20 symbols for search)

jevAspects.description: Explicit query requirements for evidence coverage

jevBlocks.description: Experimental AST excerpts for oversized functions (requires Jev both)

jevBundles.description: Experimental same-file literal constant context for Jev judgments

jevTimeoutMs.description: Whole Jev stage deadline in milliseconds (default 30000 for package context, 8000 otherwise)

gitBase.description: Git base revision used by gitChanged

embeddingTimeoutMs.description: Deadline for obtaining the query embedding

purpose.description: Ranking preset for the task (default: understand)

maxPerFile.description: Strict maximum results per file; default admits one primary and one complementary symbol (exact: 2)

tools.description: Exhaustive deterministic literal or regex search without embedding calls.

regex.description: Interpret query as a regular expression

filesystem.description: Search all ripgrep-visible filesystem files instead of the index universe

tools.name: sensegrep_show
tools.description: Expand a compact search result by resultId, optionally with graph evidence.
